Business.title: Tell us about your business
Business.intro: Your time zone decides when alerts and your weekly email arrive.
Business.quebecHint: Headroom isn't available in Quebec yet.
Business.timeZoneHint: Filled in from your device. Change it if it's wrong.

errors.nameTooLong: Use 100 characters or fewer for the name.

Bank.title: Connect your bank
Bank.intro: Headroom reads your balances and transactions to build your 13-week forecast.
Bank.readOnlyBody: Headroom can see your balances and transactions. It can't move money.
Bank.passwordTitle: Your password stays with your bank
Bank.passwordBody: You log in on your bank's own screen. Headroom never sees your password.
Bank.controlBody: Disconnect at any time, and Headroom removes that bank's data.
Bank.provider: Bank connections are provided by Plaid.

errors.connectFailed: We couldn't connect your bank. Try again.

Accounts.title: Which accounts count as cash?
Accounts.introOne: {bank} is connected. Choose what Headroom counts as cash you can spend.
Accounts.introMany: Your banks are connected. Choose what Headroom counts as cash you can spend.
Accounts.spendQuestion: Is this money you can spend?
Accounts.creditNote: Credit never counts as cash. Headroom shows what's available, and may suggest it as a fix.
Accounts.otherNote: This type of account can't count as cash.
Accounts.currencyNote: Only Canadian dollar accounts can count as cash for now.
Accounts.primaryNote: Expected payments you add go to your primary account unless you choose another.

errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save that change. Try again.
errors.noneIncluded: Choose at least one account that counts as cash.

Minimum.title: Set your minimum balance
Minimum.intro: Headroom warns you when your cash is forecast to drop below this amount.
Minimum.label: Minimum balance
Minimum.suggested: Suggested: {amount}, about two weeks of your typical spending.
Minimum.alertsBody: If your forecast dips below {amount}, you get an email that names the payments causing it and suggests ways to fix it.
Minimum.alertsBodyNoAmount: If your forecast dips below your minimum balance, you get an email that names the payments causing it and suggests ways to fix it.
Minimum.settingsNote: You can change this at any time in Settings.

errors.invalid: Enter a whole-dollar amount from $0 to {max}.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn't save your minimum balance. Try again.

Forecast.title: Building your forecast
Forecast.intro: This usually takes a minute or two.
Forecast.read: Read {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} of transactions
Forecast.footer: You'll go to your dashboard as soon as it's ready.
Forecast.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can go to your <link>dashboard</link>; your forecast will appear there when it's ready.
Forecast.needsAttention: Your bank needs you to log in again.

Banks.title: Bank connections
Banks.intro: Choose which accounts count as cash, and which one is your primary account.
Banks.otherNote: This type of account can't count as cash
Banks.currencyNote: Only Canadian dollar accounts count as cash for now
Banks.loginBanner: {bank} asked you to log in again. Until you do, your forecast is missing this bank's latest data.
Banks.syncFailingBanner: We couldn't sync {bank} for 3 nights. Until it works again, your forecast is missing this bank's latest data.
Banks.disconnectBody: Headroom stops syncing this bank and removes its accounts and transactions. This can't be undone.
Banks.readOnlyNote: Headroom has read-only access. Disconnecting a bank stops syncing and removes its data.
Banks.emptyBody: Connect your bank to see your 13-week forecast.

ExpectedPayments.intro: Payments you know are coming that Headroom can't predict from your bank data.
ExpectedPayments.emptyBody: Add a payment you know is coming, such as a large invoice, so your forecast includes it.
